author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, prefers realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM on Threads.

author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween hoodie
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s-90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13 in x 16 in); neon green, purple and orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing). Please reply with portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Follow-up: Must be an Adobe Illustrator. Please DM if available. Contact: reply on the thread or DM on Threads.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for campaign visuals
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support upcoming client projects, mainly for social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, and simple visual adaptations/resizing. Prefer someone with a good eye for clean and modern design, who can follow brand guidelines/references, is responsive, meets deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Follow-up: freelance/project-based, with potential for ongoing projects. If interested, drop portfolio and rate in the comments or DM. Contact: comments or DM on Threads.
